MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_OPPRESSIVE_SI: Each turn, on the 1st and 5th times you spend [color=#6666cc]Silence[/color], gain 1 Energy per stack. On the 2nd, 3rd, and 4th times, draw 1 card per stack. Repeat every 5 times.
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_INTERROGATION: After you play your next Attack, gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}.
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_JUDGMENT_EVE_: Whenever an enemy's intent is rewritten this combat, record 1. At the start of your turn, if at least 3 are recorded, consume all records to draw that many cards and gain that much Energy, up to {Amount}.
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_MOVIE_PROMISE: At the start of your next turn, return {Amount} promised card to your hand, make it cost 0 this turn, and generate 1 free Ethereal Exhaust card from its card pool.
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_BUTTERFLY_TAL: The next time the marked enemy damages you, record up to {Amount} damage as [color=#ff99cc]Crimson Butterfly[/color] healing. If you already have [color=#ff99cc]Crimson Butterfly[/color], add it there; otherwise heal at the start of your next turn.
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_DELAYED_CARD_: At the start of your next turn, return {Amount} stored card to your hand.
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_PRISON_IS_HOM: At the start of each turn after a turn in which you played no Attacks, enter [color=#6666cc]Cell[/color]. When you enter [color=#6666cc]Cell[/color], gain {Amount} Energy.
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_CELL_POWER.de: The first Skill you play each turn is put on top of your draw pile and costs 1 less until played. If you play an Attack, leave [color=#6666cc]Cell[/color]. At end of turn, gain {Amount} [color=#6666cc]Silence[/color] and retain up to 1 hand card.
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_PEACE_OF_MIND: Max 3. When you take any unblocked damage, lose all [color=#99ccff]Peace of Mind[/color]. Ananlin non-special cards gain hidden bonuses: Attacks deal extra damage equal to this amount; Skills gain Block equal to this amount; Powers gain [color=#6666cc]Silence[/color] equal to this amount. If you end 3 of your turns in a row with [color=#99ccff]Peace of Mind[/color], lose it and gain [color=#999999]Isolated[/color].
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_ISOLATED_POWE: You cannot gain [color=#99ccff]Peace of Mind[/color], and non-special cards do not trigger [color=#99ccff]Peace of Mind[/color] bonuses. At the start of your turn, draw 1 fewer card, halve your maximum hand size, and lose 1 Energy. Removed at the end of that turn.
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_AVERTED_GAZE_: Whenever you lose [color=#99ccff]Peace of Mind[/color], your next [b]Attack[/b] is played twice. Once per turn.
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_DELETED_STRES: The next {Amount} Attacks deal 50% less damage.
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_GROUP_CHAT_SM: Whenever a teammate plays their first card on their turn, apply {Amount} [color=#cc9966]Strange Smell[/color] to a random enemy. Each teammate can trigger this once per turn.
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_STRANGE_SMELL: When taking Attack damage, remove 1 stack and spread {Percent}% of that unblocked damage to all other enemies. If there are no other enemies, gain 1 [b]Vulnerable[/b] instead.
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_CONCEIVING_NO: Each turn, the first time each teammate plays a [b]Rare[/b] card, add a temporary copy costing 1 to your hand. It gains [b]Exhaust[/b]. If this Power came from an upgraded card, copies cost 0. After you play a draft copy, gain 1 [b]Strength[/b] and 1 [b]Dexterity[/b].
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_CLUTCH_SLEEVE: When the tracked card is played next turn, gain 1 [color=#99ccff]Peace of Mind[/color].
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_COUNT_TO_THRE: This turn, every 3 counted cards you play draws 1 card. With the Peace bonus, every 2 counted cards make the next counted card cost less.
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_COUNTDOWN_OF_: This turn, the 3rd counted card returns to your hand, costs 0, and Exhausts the next time it is played.
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_DOOR_GAP_BLOC: When the tracked card is played, gain extra Block.
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_DOOR_GAP_CONF: If you play no more [b]Attacks[/b] this turn, automatically play a copy of the tracked card at end of turn.
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_SOFT_AGREEMEN: If the tracked card is not played this turn, gain 1 [color=#99ccff]Peace of Mind[/color] at end of turn. Later, when that card is played, heal HP.
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_SYNCED_BREATH: This turn, the next time you play 2 cards of the same type in a row, gain 1 [color=#99ccff]Peace of Mind[/color] and pull cards of a different type from your piles.
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_UNNOTICED_POW: This turn, after you next play a non-[b]Attack[/b], if no enemy intends to attack, gain 1 [color=#99ccff]Peace of Mind[/color] and draw cards.
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_LIE_POWER.des: When you right-click [color=#6666cc]Silence[/color] to make monsters act immediately, clear all [color=#6666cc]Silence[/color]. For each [color=#9999ff]Lie[/color], gain {VigorPerLie:diff()} [b]Vigor[/b], then gain 1 random 0-cost stable multi-hit [b]Attack[/b] from all character card pools that can currently be played. Then lose all [color=#9999ff]Lie[/color].
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_LIE_POWER.sma: After right-clicking [color=#6666cc]Silence[/color], clear all [color=#6666cc]Silence[/color] and gain Vigor plus a 0-cost multi-hit [b]Attack[/b].
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_DRAFT_REWRITE: At the start of each turn, you may choose 1 card in your hand and transform it into a card from any other character card pool. If the transformed card's pool is already recorded by Anan's Sketchbook or is recorded this way, add a copy of the transformed card to your deck. If the Sketchbook has recorded 3 pools, you may first remove 1 deck card from a recorded pool and forget that pool.
At the start of each turn, you may rewrite 1 card in hand and try to record its new pool in Anan's Sketchbook.
Choose a deck card to remove and forget its pool
MANOSABA_LIN_POWER_ANANLIN_SILENT_AMPLIF: Whenever you have replaced {Rewrites:diff()} monster intents in total, increase the base multiplier of Silence replacement intents by 1 for this combat. This Power's number is the current multiplier.
Every {Rewrites:diff()} replaced intents increases the Silence replacement intent multiplier by 1.
